_about: THE API'S COPY IS THE MASTER (chitbridge-api docs/contracts/web-api.json). chitbridge-web keeps e2e/fixtures/web-api.contract.json - the same file. tests/web-api-contract.test.cjs holds the API's real answers to it; chitbridge-web e2e/contract.cjs holds every stand-in to it. Change the shape of an answer here (node tests/web-api-contract.test.cjs --write), then copy the file across.
